variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Oh, curse them all! Those Urchins have been into my mill again?!

They crawled up out of that old barrow east of the ford, and this time they took my ring of keys. The grain loft, the sluice, the front door -- all locked tight and me stood on the wrong side of them!

Go into the barrow and get my keys back. I'll teach you a spell for your trouble, and a good one.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
My keys! Every last one of them! Oh, thank you, lad! Here's the spell book I promised you. Study it hard.

And go and see Brother Anselm at the Chapel of the Ford. His boy Pip never came back out of that barrow.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's mill keys from the Urchins' barrow.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Reeve Halvard is the finest Reeve Brackenford ever had! When he says this gate stays shut, it stays shut!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: This is Dunstan's forge. Best steel on the Bracken! How can I help you?

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: Ask at the Drowned Lantern. Ossian knows everybody's business.

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: I've heard the Urchins stuff what they steal into barrels and crates. Smash them open and see!

variants.specifics: Bormunt: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ulbo
offer.text:
Sir! Over here! Help me, please! I've been bitten and I can hardly stand!

Abominable Giant Leeches have infested the flooded gallery below the old pump house, south of here. They fell upon me as I was lighting the lamps. Their infestation imperils the entire lower mine, and no miner dares set foot down there now. If you would exterminate these loathsome creatures, I will see you suitably rewarded. Will you do it?

completion.speaker: Ulbo
completion.text:
You've destroyed them?! Splendid! Splendid!

Take this bow. It was found lying beside an old skeleton in the lower shafts, and nobody ever came to claim it. It's yours now. Guildmaster Brannoc is asking for you at the Guild Hall.

journal.text: Destroy the Giant Leeches in the flooded gallery.

guard.speaker: Tavik
guard.text: This is Bormunt, the greatest mine under Mount Grull! Show some respect when you go in.

shop.speaker: Ilvane
shop.text: The Azure Circle is the sole purveyor of potions and scrolls to the mines of Bormunt. State your needs.

townsfolk1.speaker: Orrin
townsfolk1.text: Not now, stranger. The bell's rung for my shift.

townsfolk2.speaker: Elsbeth
townsfolk2.text: Somebody's been eating my candles again! Who would do such a thing?!

variants.specifics: Oskry: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Quillon
offer.text: Gone! Gone! Those rotten little Imps came in my window last night and took my magic lantern right off its hook! And they tracked mud all over my floor! I can't do a bit of work without that lantern. Would you get it back for me?

completion.speaker: Quillon
completion.text: My lantern! My lantern! Thank you, thank you! Here, take this Ankh. A peddler sold it to me for good luck. It never brought me any, so maybe it will do better for you.

journal.text: Get Quillon's magic lantern back from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Tobben
guard.text: Good day, stranger! This is Oskry, the proudest village in all the Blackwater!

shop.speaker: Durl
shop.text: Welcome to the Dry Plank! Driest beds in the swamp! Well... Mostly dry.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townswoman
townsfolk1.text: Did you hear? The dead climbed up the ladders again last night!

townsfolk2.speaker: Glynna
townsfolk2.text: Well, hello there! You're the first visitor all year that isn't green and dripping! Hee, hee, hee!

variants.specifics: Castle Brask: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Paymaster Fennig
offer.text: Good day. I presume you are here about the notice on the gate. Imps have got into the garrison's granary, south of the castle by the old mill, and they are eating our winter stores! If you could drive them out, you'd save my position! I am held to account for every sack. There is a reward, of course.

completion.speaker: Paymaster Fennig
completion.text:
The Imps are gone? Splendid! The winter stores are saved!

As promised, here is your reward. A deserter left this bow behind when he ran off in the night. It is a perfectly good bow.

journal.text: Drive the Imps out of the garrison's granary.

guard.speaker: Brunn
guard.text: Good day, stranger. If you go out again, keep off the marsh road. A cart went missing on it only yesterday.

shop.speaker: Bortho
shop.text: A customer! Half the street's packed up and gone since the dead started walking. I'll be next if business doesn't pick up.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townswoman
townsfolk1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Iron Kettle. Soldiers can't keep their mouths shut after a cup or two.

townsfolk2.speaker: Soldier
townsfolk2.text: Did you hear? The dead came over the north wall again last night!

variants.specifics: Vesk: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
offer.text: Hail, Wanderer! Want to learn a spell? Then do me a favor. The Urchins in the caves on the east shore stole my spyglass right off my ferry! I can't keep watch on the Weeping Isle without it. Bring it back and I'll teach you a fine spell. Is it a bargain?

completion.speaker: Ambrus the Ferryman
completion.text: My spyglass! Not a scratch on it! Here, take this book. The spell inside is yours now. Learn it well!

journal.text: Recover Ambrus' spyglass from the Urchins of the east shore.

guard.speaker: Dolf
guard.text: Welcome to the Village of Vesk! The Leaky Bucket is just up the dock road. A warm bed for the weary!

shop.speaker: Dorgo
shop.text: Ah, a customer! My potions cost a bit more than in the city. But then, the city is a long row away, isn't it?

townsfolk1.speaker: Mott
townsfolk1.text: Sorry, I've got nets to mend. Try me later.

townsfolk2.speaker: Tib
townsfolk2.text: Stay away from the water after dark. The dead come up out of it!

variants.specifics: Vorne: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gostrel
offer.text:
Ow! Ow! Sir! Help me, get them off!

Wasps! Giant ones! Sarvok's Imps drove them down off Gallow Ridge and now they've built a nest in my herb garden, west of the Lyceum behind the old sundial.

Go and burn that nest out. Do it and I'll teach you a spell worth knowing.

completion.speaker: Gostrel
completion.text: Burned it out? Ha! Good riddance! Here, the spell I promised you. Take it.

journal.text: Destroy the Wasp nest in Gostrel's herb garden.

guard.speaker: Torrik
guard.text: Thinking of slipping out the north gate, are you? Try it, and you'll spend the night in the cell underneath it!

shop.speaker: Grenda
shop.text: Welcome to the Singing Kettle, finest inn in all of Nox! Well... finest in Vorne, anyway. Sit yerself down.

townsfolk1.speaker: Student
townsfolk1.text: Looking for gossip? The Singing Kettle is where the students go to complain.

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: I hear the Golems on Gallow Ridge are terribly slow. Run, and they'll never catch you!

variants.specifics: Fort Kholm: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gorrin
offer.text:
Bother and blast! Robbed again?! Those nefarious little Urchins crept into the signal tower in the night and pilfered my spyglass! Without it I cannot keep watch on the pass. Ulvana's Undead could march right up to the gate and I would be none the wiser!

The thieves keep a den in the Snow Caves, west of the Ice Bridge. If you could get my spyglass back, the whole fort would sleep easier. Will you go after it?

completion.speaker: Gorrin
completion.text:
My spyglass! Splendid! Now I can resume my vigil.

Here, take this spell book. A traveling Wizard left it with me years ago to pay for his supper. I never could make sense of a word in it.

journal.text: Recover Gorrin's spyglass from the Urchins in the Snow Caves.

guard.speaker: Brunn
guard.text: This is the north gate, Marshal Odric's post. The pass beyond is closed to all.

shop.speaker: Thudd
shop.text: Welcome to Thudd's Armory! Best steel on the mountain! And if it won't kill the Undead, you can always use it to chip the ice off your beard!

townsfolk1.speaker: Hagen
townsfolk1.text: Stay away from the high pass after dark! The dead walk up there!

townsfolk2.speaker: Lissa
townsfolk2.text: Ooh, a new face in the fort! Come warm yourself by my fire some night, when you're done with all that fighting.

variants.specifics: Fornath: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Krall
offer.text:
Moreover, production in the slag pits has ceased entirely. Entirely! Ever since those Ember Demons came crawling up out of the vents.

These abominable creatures appeared the very night Gorvane's Ogres seized the Black Smeltery. My workers have been forced to abandon their posts and the pits are now wholly besieged. Irregardless of the danger, the pits must be reclaimed for Fornath.

Here, take this iron key, it will open the gate to the slag pits at the east end of town. Descend into the pits and eradicate every last one of these nefarious beasts. Report back to me when it is done.

completion.speaker: Krall
completion.text:
Splendid! The slag pits are liberated at last! My workers can return to their labors.

Take this shield as a token of my appreciation. You will have need of it, with Gorvane's Ogres still up on the mountain.

journal.text: Eradicate the Ember Demons in the slag pits.

guard.speaker: Bodo
guard.text: Welcome to Fornath, stranger! Home of the great Master Kasrak and the hottest forges in all of Nox!

shop.speaker: Zibba
shop.text: Ooh, a new face! I can always spot the new ones, they've still got their eyebrows! Come in, come in!

townsfolk1.speaker: Kettla
townsfolk1.text: Sorry, can't talk now. My crucible's about to spill.

townsfolk2.speaker: Bessamy
townsfolk2.text: Did you hear? Ogres up at the Black Smeltery! Ogres!

variants.specifics: Wendle Cross: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Belgrin
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. You find me in a most deplorable predicament. In the dead of night a horde of malodorous Imps invaded my house and purloined my enchanted Lantern! Without it I cannot find my own door after sundown. If you could get it back, you would save an old man a great deal of misery. Will you undertake this task?

completion.speaker: Belgrin
completion.text: My Lantern! You have recovered it! I am in your debt, kind sir. Here are 100 gold pieces, a modest recompense for your valor.

journal.text: Recover Lord Belgrin's enchanted Lantern from the Imps.

guard.speaker: Brask
guard.text: This is the tower of Telmarq the Arch-Wizard.

shop.speaker: Odo
shop.text: Welcome to the Crooked Kettle! Prices went up a bit since the roads closed. Can't be helped, friend!

townsfolk1.speaker: Hesta
townsfolk1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Crooked Kettle. Odo hears everything that comes down the four roads.

townsfolk2.speaker: Mungo
townsfolk2.text: Whose bright idea was it to build the new stables on top of the old graveyard? Now the horses won't go in at all!

variants.specifics: Hestle: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hoskin
offer.text: Sir! Over here, quick! Giant leeches have crawled up out of my well house south of the farm, and they've had my goats! Here, drink this if they bite you. Now get in there and kill the lot of them.

completion.speaker: Hoskin
completion.text: Gone? Truly gone? Oh, thank goodness! Here, take the key to my boat. It's tied up down at the river. Use it whenever you like.

journal.text: Kill the giant leeches in Hoskin's well house.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: This is the north gate of Hestle, and it stays shut.

shop.speaker: Gorrick
shop.text: Welcome! I make armor for heroes and horseshoes for everybody else. What'll it be?

townsfolk1.speaker: Greda
townsfolk1.text: Mayor Dulvane? The old windbag hasn't poked his nose out of the Town Hall since the Ogres came!

townsfolk2.speaker: Hoskin
townsfolk2.text: Beware of the north road after dark! The Ogres come down off the hill with torches.
